pieces.Text: You gain the frightful presence ability.

The aegis makes his astral suit unsettling to his foes, gaining the frightful presence ability.  The aegis can activate this ability as part of an offensive action, such as a charge or attack.  Opponents within
feet of the aegis must make a

Will save or become shaken for 3d6 rounds.  If the aegis has at least 4 more Hit Dice than an opponent, that opponent becomes frightened instead.  Foes with more HD than the aegis are immune to this effect.
